bio: Courtyard by Marriott Oxford South is a 4-star hotel, situated between Abingdon and Didcot.  Afternoon Tea is served in Oxen Restaurant, a casual brasserie, with leather snugs, exposed bricks and handwoven textures.  Enjoy a traditional Afternoon Tea menu of sandwiches, scones and cakes. Add a glass of sparkling wine or a gin & tonic to celebrate a special occasion.  A Vegan Afternoon Tea menu is also available on request. For any other special dietary requirements please specify details when making a booking.  Afternoon Tea costs £14.95 per person and is served every day from 12pm to 5pm.
